name: vlm_actin_stress_fiber_alignment
description: Visually scores the alignment and prominence of actin stress fibers. While code can measure anisotropy, VLM can better judge the 'distinctness' and 'parallelism' in a biological context.
segmentation_prompt: Segment individual cells showing actin cytoskeleton.
method_rationale: Humans (and VLMs) are very good at perceiving 'pattern coherence' and 'fiber distinctness' which can be noisy in pixel-level gradient statistics.
